notes.title: Introducing "AI Confidential" from Narcosis' narrative team!
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/LUEqaVVl_9s?si=3_7sUb1LqJdK3qZt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9759705/662eb4daff0cc1ecfe22da8dff08d8ff8a244042.png[/img]
[/url]
[b]And now for something completely different...:[/b] The writer and lead VO actor of [i]Narcosis[/i] are set to spin-up an all-new, narrative-driven story set in a deceptively utopian future: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2982490/AI_Confidential][i][b]AI Confidential[/b][/i][/url].

[url=https://youtu.be/LUEqaVVl_9s?si=3_7sUb1LqJdK3qZt]Watch the trailer here[/url], then read on for more info!

[b]Artificial Intelligence, Real Problems.[/b]
You are Makenzy Turner, an affable RoboTechnician employed by AI megacorp, Indelligent Solutions. 
With your trusty assistant ARI, use high-tech tools and old-fashioned empathy to mend everything from broken parts to broken hearts.

Like [i]Narcosis[/i], [i]AIC[/i] will feature an intricately-crafted narrative and top-notch VO performances... [i]and may make you a little misty-eyed[/i]...
 
...[u]Unlike[/u] [i]Narcosis[/i], the game features a cast of quirky, lovable characters to get to know (and - possibly - pull their plugs), a sprawling narrative packed with tough subjective choices and subversive humor, and... a unique and intuitive emoji-based conversation system. 

If this tickles your fancy, we hope you'll follow, like or wishlist and come along for the ride - we're still in the early stages (demo coming... soon!), but for now the future looks pretty damn bright...

notes.title: One Year Later: Major Content Update
notes.content:
[i]Narcosis[/i] debuted one year ago today, so as a 'thank you' to all of you who've taken this journey with us — and those still to come — we've updated the Steam edition of the game with some very exciting extras...

First up: "[i]Raptures of the Deep: A Journey into Narcosis[/i]," 15 ambient tracks inspired by our deep-sea survival story, including the eponymous closing theme from celebrated composer [b]Akira Yamaoka[/b] ([i]Silent Hill[/i] series). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/cf1b9e5a4a8823885b5d30800f1acbdf3b7467f1.png[/img]

Also included: "[i]Hell or Highwater: Surviving Oceanova[/i]," survivor Kip Mattas' official, first-person account of the catastrophe that captivated the world's attention on the Feb 21, 2021. Previously available only via Amazon, it's now included with the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/657c64cef34558d21a647afcfd9c2dfbcae7038e.png[/img]

Finally, we've also included the entire accompanying radio interview with Mr. Mattas on [i]Open Air[/i], now downloadable for your on-the-go listening pleasure. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/2fda7d4f1d112053be0d8be114e96ab2a346969c.png[/img] 

For those of you interested in seeing how deep the game's narrative threads go, we hope you'll enjoy these 'supplementary materials,' which — in conjunction with the game, itself — comprise the "complete [i]Narcosis[/i] experience."

Thanks again, and remember: if you've enjoyed your time with our debut title, we hope you'll take a moment to spread the word, or leave a review. [i]Narcosis[/i] is a small fish in a mighty big sea, and your support makes a difference. 

[b]Honor Code, Inc.[/b]

notes.title: (Difficulty) Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear divers...

Since Narcosis launched (nearly a year ago!) we've received quite a bit of praise, and not a few criticisms. In particular, there's one key level midway through the game that's a little less... explicit in its instructions, as to where to go, and how to get there. Those of you who've played it may remember the eighth level - fittingly called "[i]FOLLOW PROCEDURE[/i]" - in which the Survivor finds himself (even more) lost and directionless, after an... unexpected encounter. 

Having read your feedback, and watched dozens of streams, we got the gang back together to try and make this particular section just a little bit easier. [i]Narcosis[/i] is - at its dark heart - a survivor's story, and we hate to think that some of you might opt not to reach the (bitter? sweet?) conclusion, on account of some poor game balancing.  

If all that is too cryptic, a transcript of the change log is pasted below. Nothing too spoiler-y, but it's redacted, just in case...

Whether its your first time playing, or if you're going through again to try and uncover some of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/366870/discussions/0/135514402721509373/] many, many secrets[/url] we've stashed deep beneath the sea, we hope you'll enjoy the journey, and share your thoughts with us.

Finally, the one-year anniversary of the game's release is approaching. With that in mind, we've got a few more exciting announcements incoming... So watch this space!

[b]Change Log:[/b] 
[spoiler]
+ Changed start point
+ Changed blinking light depending of that new position (it disappears in the desert... That's normal)
+ Changed some fishes' paths
+ Added new trigger for spider in the desert
+ Added some path to go to the other side
+ Added anemones glowing in order to lure player to the other side
+ Changed a bit the slide of the volcanoes to better trap player
+ Made easier to climb the new way from the volcano to the exit[/spoiler]

notes.title: Narcosis is 33% off, and now with Oculus Touch support!
notes.content:
[h1]Want to cool down from the summer heat?[/h1]

Now's the chance, enjoy the cold depths at [b]33% off[/b] during the Steam summer sales.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/1e6e309da1c256080f6b7ed46770961c4ce02b5f.png[/img]

[h1]Occulus Touch Support[/h1]

Adding to our support to VR platforms, we want to make sure that you can play on these with the associated input methods. 
Now, as we already discussed with some of you in the forums, we won't be able to support full motion controls, as that would require a significant amount of rework.

That said, you can now enjoy Narcosis using Oculus Touch controllers, with the following (for now) fixed control scheme : 
[list]
[*]Stick (Left Touch)  : Movement
[*]Stick (Right Touch) : Rotation
[*]A (Right Touch) : Use/Menu validation
[*]B (Right Touch) : Cancel
[*]Y (Left Touch) : Recenter VR sensor
[*]Trigger (Left Touch) : Knife
[*]Trigger (Right Touch) : Flares
[*]Grip (Any Touch) : Thruster
[*]Menu key (L touch) : Menu
[/list]

Vive controllers support is coming up as well, just need a bit more work. 

[b]Changelist [v1.1.3.18535][/b]
[list]
[*] Oculus Touch Support (see above)
[*] Fixed the achievements "Signs of Life" and "Memento Mori" that didn't trigger for some people. If you're among them, they should unlock once you launch the game with this new update. (Thanks to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198108973018]Altermind[/url] for helping out with this)
[*] Balanced a bit oxygen supplies in some levels.
[/list]

notes.title: New Patch is Up (v1.1.2.18509)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/fe343ed07bbaea900ee955e53aeb8fc40f06c8e3.png[/img]

Some players have noticed that another patch's gone live. Mostly "[i]behind the scenes[/i]" stuff, but in the interest of transparency, here's what's changed:

Changelist [v1.1.2.18509] 
[list]
    [*]Safe Zone decals updated upon level save
    [*]Minor memory optimizations
    [*]The "Wanderer effect" works when Vsync is "off" and running at a high framerate
    [*]Japanese subtitles fixed
    [*]"You're an engineer" VO subtitles fixed (all languages)
 [*]Vertices adjusted in cafeteria so the "blood room" doors don't clip through walls
 [*]Player-collider fixed on crane in training pool
 [*]Fixed unclamped shader that occasionally causes a "white flash" 
 [*]Interpolation added to the mist-on-glass effect (to prevent flashing in/out)
    [*]Fixed continue button displaying "commence"
    [*]Credits updated
    [*]"Open Air" no longer unlocked prior to credits
    [*]Cuttlefish attack angle adjusted in "Back to Normal"
    [*]Main Menu options adjusted: now says "Continue" instead of "Start Over" upon reaching the final sequence
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/ecca8b7f765e4e48572b33eaba88ee3287e8b69f.png[/img]

Subtitles in a few new languages are on the way, and future updates to address some of the most outstanding requests and criticisms are in the works; watch this space for updates.

Thanks for playing, and the warm reception to this survival story, set beneath the sea. If you like what we've done, please encourage others to #PlayNarcosis for themselves, or maybe leave a Steam review - every bit helps!

Have a great weekend, 

[b]Honor Code[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/d01b4dac41d2669b07a3c85ad7472eed03a18b64.png[/img]

notes.title: The Art of the Abyss + UPDATES
notes.content:
[i]Narcosis[/i] is entering its second week, and continues to earn accolades for its unique setting, haunting ambience, and unique style of story-telling. We're working to address as many player issues as possible; an update just went live that includes: 
[list]
    [*][b]ULTRA-WIDESCREEN SUPPORT[/b]
    [*]Revised (English) post-mortem and relic text 
    [*]Various bug fixes and "behind the scenes" design tweaks
[/list]
Have you been enjoying [i]Narcosis[/i]? Reached the bitter(sweet?) conclusion to our survivor's tale? Good or bad, we hope you'll share your thoughts, or consider leaving a review — as a small team just getting its start, every bit of encouragement, feedback or (constructive) criticism helps...

And now for something sweet, to savor this weekend...
Jeremy Briel runs a gaming blog dedicated to artistic, professional-looking screenshots of games. Officially and as a fan, he's captured and shared stunning shots of all sorts of games — ranging from uber-indie to AAA — including [i]Abzu[/i], [i]Albino Lullaby[/i], [i]Bioshock[/i], [i]Caffeine[/i], and [i]Layers of Fear[/i].  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/3d53093c88d6ab47b82b8b8a0f0babaa16fd9175.png[/img]

Jeremy reached out to us recently about putting his unique spin on [i]Narcosis[/i], and after one look at his prolific portfolio, we couldn't refuse. Some samples of his work are below; we'll be posting more from time to time here. If you like what you see, and have a few hours to spare, make sure to drop by his blog and lose yourself in his incredible work...

More at http://digitalfrontiers.tumblr.com

notes.title: Wow, what a week... [Collectibles, Updates and More]
notes.content:
[i]Narcosis[/i] has shipped, and by and large players, streamers and press seem to enjoy our survivor's story, and the strange paths it takes...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/e134e812cce9f09400811824633412c316d0e4a1.png[/img]

[b]A few updates:[/b]
[b]Trading Cards[/b], [b]Badges[/b] and [b]Emoticons[/b] are now online, and ready to be earned. Who'll be the first to collect all six cards...?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/9380ece5b034b07f9f2c716ca3d4f5f80319e31f.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/d516df497e5e1a31326cac1c3a4d8e89422bc548.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/6c9858c850c36b157787fd2a67675b84e12eb2f6.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/c12c0aa782d59f11b21e6ff2621dc5f38d839c3d.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/8ee0b5414680ed6d0d0e3867701356ca22c28427.png[/img]

We've made a few bug fixes, including:
[list]
    [*]Invert Y-Axis now works w/mouse+keyboard
    [*]Fixed flare trajectory offset
    [*]Additional bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]
Additional improvements - [b]including ultra-wide support[/b] - are on the way...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/efaa5a04fef11ca5ca2f65b933b0d5f5ec49554c.png[/img]

We're so grateful for the warm response, and would love to hear your thoughts. Have you recovered all the ID tags? Unearthed all the 'relics'? If you've played through to the bitter end, please consider taking the time to leave an honest review, and let us know what your thoughts. For this first-time team, visibility is everything, and every bit helps...

notes.title: Dispatches from the Depths: 9/28
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/c7ea4f4abeab33951129501de3a8f657d8e0bacf.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

to put it mildly, we haven't been as good as we should, about keeping in touch. But we're in the final stretches: the game's being refined rapidly, day by day, and we're looking forward to sharing more — and more frequent — updates with you (Including a trailer) in the weeks to come...

Lately, we've been asked a lot about a launch date. To be honest, we're reluctant to make more promises, as they're easily broken ([b]Exhibit A:[/b] our trailer, which mentions a "2014 release"). 

But rest assured development continues 24/7 (literally: some of the team's based in the SF Bay Area, with the rest spread across  several cities in France), and we'll have news to share on this front soon. Most of us have been working on [i]Narcosis[/i] for over three years — so we're determined to bring you something special.

If you're looking for even more frequent updates — or feel like helping us get the word out — we hope you'll join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/NarcosisGame/]Facebook[/url] and/or [url=https://twitter.com/narcosisgame]Twitter[/url].

Some recent developments: 
[list]
[*]Our French team just wrapped up a three week workshop in Angoulême. We only see one another a few times a year, so it was a great chance to get together, and a lot accomplished. Pics [url=https://www.facebook.com/NarcosisGame/photos/?tab=album&album_id=1218964074820346]here[/url], if you're curious.
[*]At the same time, we wrapped our second and final VO recording session — below's a photo of voice actor [url=https://twitter.com/JeffMattas]Jeff Mattas[/url], and a mystery guest...
[*]In addition to numerous visual and UX changes, here are some cool new features recently added to the game:
[*][b]VFX: [/b]ink and blood, storms and particles... 
[*][b]First-person animations: [/b]flare-launching, knife-swinging, object-collecting and... 
[*][b]DYING.[/b][/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/fb63a1239041870ce72bd27031c0f280425470b7.png[/img]
